paragraphs.en: Thanksgiving Farms is 57 acres. We like to grow a little bit of the odd and unusual. So, we grow pretty much everything.
paragraphs.zh: 感恩节农场占地57英亩。我们喜欢种植一些稀奇古怪的作物。我们基本上什么都种。

paragraphs.en: The only thing we do not grow is corn. We're ladies. Corn is heavy and we're not picking it. I run the garden center part.
paragraphs.zh: 我们唯一不种的就是玉米。我们是女士。玉米太重了，我们收不起来。我负责经营园艺中心的部分。

paragraphs.en: I have 20 grow houses full of plants right now. I grow everything from petunias to Calibrachoas to tropical plants.
paragraphs.zh: 我现在有20个种满植物的大棚。我种植矮牵牛花、百万铃、热带植物等植物。

paragraphs.en: I plant them at a certain time so that they get ready by Mother's Day. Mother's Day is our Christmas in the greenhouse industry.
paragraphs.zh: 我在特定时间种植它们，以便它们在母亲节前上市。母亲节相当于温室花卉行业的圣诞节。

paragraphs.en: That's when everybody brings their mom out. They get flowers.
paragraphs.zh: 那时每个人都带着他们的妈妈出来买花。

paragraphs.en: In normal years,we have half of it sold by May 10, and then you sell the rest of it at the end of May and two weeks into June.
paragraphs.zh: 正常年景时，我们到5月10日会售出一半，然后在五月底和六月的头两周内卖出剩余部分。

paragraphs.en: On a glorious sunny Saturday afternoon in May, we have 75 to 100 cars in our parking lot.
paragraphs.zh: 五月一个晴朗的星期六下午，我们停车场里有75到100辆车。

paragraphs.en: When I heard about the coronavirus, I went and I turned all my greenhouses down 10 degrees, just to try to get my plants in a holding pattern, because I don't know when I'm going to be able to sell them.
paragraphs.zh: 当我听说冠状病毒时，我去把所有温室的温度调低了10度，只是想让我的植物生长放缓，因为我不知道什么时候才能把它们卖出去。

paragraphs.en: In danger of losing, besides my sanity and the lining of my stomach. That is a horrible, horrible thing to think about.
paragraphs.zh: 有失去一切的危险，我吃不下去饭。一想到这个，就觉得可怕极了。

paragraphs.en: I want to be optimistic, but at the end of the day I know realistically a monetary amount, I don't know, a lot. Hundreds of thousands of dollars, a lot.
paragraphs.zh: 我想保持乐观，但说到底，我只知道开支很大，具体多少我不清楚，反正很多，几十万美元。

paragraphs.en: This gets me through the day. My stomach, that is where my stress went. It went into my stomach. So, I'm living on Coke Zero and Tums right now.
paragraphs.zh: 我熬过了一天。我从心底感到了压力，胃很难受。我现在就靠零度可乐和抗胃酸咀嚼钙片活着。

paragraphs.en: You do what you got to do. It is a very rare bird that wants to one day go, oh, I want to farm. Pretty sure you have to be born into it.
paragraphs.zh: 你得做你该做的事。会有人某天突然说“我想务农”可是少之又少。肯定是生来就是农民。

paragraphs.en: To be a farmer, you have to be optimistic. You have to be a gambler. Sometimes, you have a thunderstorm that will wipe your seeds.
paragraphs.zh: 作为一个农民，你必须乐观。你必须赌上一把。有时候，一场雷暴就会把种子毁于一旦。

paragraphs.en: Sometimes, you get it all the way down and you're two weeks from harvesting your field, and you get a 15-minute hailstorm that totally disintegrates everything.
paragraphs.zh: 有时，你必须在两周内收割完毕，15分钟的冰雹会把所有东西都毁掉。

paragraphs.en: You just have to go, oh, OK, well let's start over. That's what you got to do or else you will never make it. One day at a time. Yep, that's all you can do.
paragraphs.zh: 你只能说，我们重新开始。那是你必须做的，否则你永远都做不成。一天一天慢慢来。这就是你能做的全部。

paragraphs.en: Nobody has ever prepared you for a pandemic, ever. So, I'm going to dig in deep.
paragraphs.zh: 从来没有人让你为疫情做好准备。我要深入挖掘。

paragraphs.en: I'm going to probably stay up many nights trying to figure out how to get through this. But, we will. I will find a way.
paragraphs.zh: 我可能要熬很多个晚上想办法渡过难关。但是，我们会挺过去的。我会找到办法的。

paragraphs.en: I'm not going to let this take away my identity of something that I have worked on my entire life. I've been in this business since I was five.
paragraphs.zh: 我不会让这件事夺走我为之奋斗一生的身份。我从五岁就开始做这行了。

paragraphs.en: I am not going to give it up to COVID-19. Believe me. That is not going to take us out. We will find a way. Just getting there is going to be the hard part.
paragraphs.zh: 我不会向新冠病毒屈服。相信我，它击不垮我们。我们会找到解决办法的。只是通往成功的道路将充满艰辛。
